zh: 侧栏里对话的状态标记换了一副样子：正在进行的对话不再转圈，改成一盏呼吸的灰灯，实心圆点每 2.4 秒从半亮到全亮一个来回，位置与大小都不动；空闲对话的空心圆与它同样 6px，圈线是 1px 发丝、颜色更淡，两枚标记只靠实心与空心区分，已归档列表里的那枚空心圆跟着一起改，两栏的标题仍从同一处开始。设置的「动画效果」选「减弱」时灯停在最亮的那一帧。
en: A conversation's status mark in the sidebar is drawn differently: a running conversation breathes instead of spinning, a lit grey dot whose light rises from half to full and back once every 2.4 seconds while it neither moves nor changes size, and an idle conversation keeps a hollow circle of the same 6px with a 1px hairline stroke in the quieter neutral, so the two marks differ by fill alone; the archived list's circle follows them and both lists still start their titles at the same place. Under the Animation setting's Reduced the light holds its brightest frame.
